name: AI Usage
description:
Your AI subscriptions' rate limits in the top bar: one button, with a tab per provider showing the current session, the week and each model, and when each resets.

Claude (Claude Code), Google Antigravity and Codex are supported, each switched on or off separately, and a tab for Ollama lists the local server's models. Each needs its command-line tool installed and signed in: the extension reads the login that tool has stored and sends it only to that provider's own server, as the tool does. It never signs you in or refreshes a login itself; if one has expired, the pop-up asks you to run the tool once. For Claude and Codex, the pop-up's refresh button runs the tool's own doctor command, so the tool refreshes it, and does so unasked once a login expires unless a switch says to wait for the tool.

The Ollama tab asks only the Ollama server (127.0.0.1:11434, or OLLAMA_HOST) and keeps this session's figures in a file under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ai-usage/, which is gone at logout.
